summary: This is a Gherkin test scenario that verifies a basic navigation feature. It checks that when a user visits the Avonture website and clicks the Blog menu, they are taken to the blog page at the /blog URL.

explanations.1: The Feature line describes the overall user-facing capability being tested — in this case, that clicking Blog in the menu should show articles.
explanations.3: Scenario labels an individual test case that exercises one specific path through the feature.
explanations.4: Given sets up the starting condition — the test begins with the user already on the homepage.
explanations.5: Then is an action step — the user performs a click on the Blog menu item.
explanations.6: Then is an assertion step — it verifies the expected outcome, that the URL changed to /blog.
